text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear anti-driverless position from start to finish","quality":"argumentative stance","description":"It maintains a definite position and keeps defending that position throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"sensor list and $200 million radar quote","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It brings in several specific details from the article to support its claims."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs with cost, safety, and technology points","quality":"organization","description":"It develops the argument in a more structured way with separate reasons in different paragraphs."},{"evidence":"“To begin,” “To continue,” “Next,” “To conclude”","quality":"transitional control","description":"It uses signposting words that help the reader follow the progression of ideas."},{"evidence":"mentions liability, laws, and accidents","quality":"reasoned analysis","description":"It goes beyond simple opinion by explaining practical problems that could come with driverless cars."},{"evidence":"counterargument language like “Some may argue” and “Opposers think”","quality":"engagement with opposing views","description":"It acknowledges another side before responding to it, which makes the argument feel more deliberate."}]}
